source: Proposal · 2026-10-09 · lore expansion draft for creator review
about: Every typed tie between the 42 key players. All 861 pairs of characters are within three steps of each other. visibility: public = the city knows; private = insiders know; secret = one side, or almost no one, knows.

clusters.name: The Wells
clusters.binds: The Accord, the Seventh Clause and the sealed freight: the people who built the arrangement and keep it running.

clusters.name: The Deep
clusters.binds: The Ironfist-Stonefist schism and the tunnels that reach the Sump.

clusters.name: Carmine Night
clusters.binds: The fire six years ago, and the shadow trade that staffed it.

clusters.name: Bodies
clusters.binds: The fight over what a body is for: the wards, the clinic, the lab, and three faiths.

clusters.name: Downhill trade
clusters.binds: Everything that moves down the hill and back up: filters, food, freight, Hush and moss.

ties.label: mother and son, estranged
ties.description: Elandor is Elandra's son. He took his father's house name and left the Heights sixty years ago; they haven't spoken in forty.

ties.label: mentor and protégé
ties.description: Silvyr is Elandra's chosen successor and writes her law. She doesn't know what the law is for.

ties.label: the secret they share
ties.description: Faelar has kept Elandra's secret for eighty years and has started to wonder who it protects.

ties.label: Accord co-signers
ties.description: Co-signers of the Unity Accord: respect, a long chess game, one shared silence.

ties.label: the Seventh Clause
ties.description: Julian drafted the Seventh Clause at Elandra's table.

ties.label: Council rivals
ties.description: Elandra votes; Morgana only speaks. Elandra has never once looked away while she does.

ties.label: his house's debt
ties.description: House Silvershade bought the dry Altherion well's debt. Lysanthir hosts her gatherings and owes her his name.

ties.label: the sealed night freight
ties.description: The sealed Archive freight on the 3:10 runs under Elandra's seal. Thrombur has carried it for 61 years without asking.

ties.label: inherited contract
ties.description: Thrain's father signed the Lattice contract with Elandra. Thrain inherited the contract and the silence.

ties.label: former lovers
ties.description: Together for a century, apart for ninety years. They still dine on the first of every month.

ties.label: Last Call circle
ties.description: Two of the city's three great bartenders. He calls her "the young one" and means it as a title.

ties.label: Last Call circle
ties.description: Bartenders for a combined four centuries. They argue about glassware and nothing else.

ties.label: an unpaid favor
ties.description: Aerendir owes Lysanthir for the introduction that made his fortune. It hasn't been called in.

ties.label: her drafting table
ties.description: Silvyr drafts at his corner table. He reads upside down.

ties.label: secret funding
ties.description: Aerendir funds Lena's research through a shell grant so the truth breaks on his schedule. She doesn't know.

ties.label: the Carmine Night payment
ties.description: Aerendir paid for the Carmine Night, both the fire and the hero.

ties.label: the Carmine contracts
ties.description: Milo brokered the Carmine Night contracts for Aerendir.

ties.label: votes together, bets against
ties.description: Aerendir's house holds a minor well. He votes with Elandra and bets against her.

ties.label: drafting rivals
ties.description: They redline each other's drafts weekly and lunch together after. She trusts his words; she shouldn't.

ties.label: former handler, defector
ties.description: Lireal was Faelar's best illusionist. She walked out with a copy of his network map. He let her, and neither knows why.

ties.label: the smuggling he allows
ties.description: Faelar knows Jax smuggles out the people Faelar is meant to remove, and lets it run.

ties.label: surveillance
ties.description: Faelar's songbird has sat outside Lena's lab window for three years.

ties.label: handler and asset
ties.description: Julian reports to Faelar after every negotiation.

ties.label: reads the post
ties.description: The Quiet Office reads the city post. Thrombur knows and hand-delivers anything that matters.

ties.label: the missing-persons files
ties.description: Erica's disappearance files keep ending at the gates of Elven Heights.

ties.label: the staged standoff
ties.description: Elara ran Maxwell's first campaign and staged the Unity Plaza standoff he "defused." She kept proof.

ties.label: the buried data
ties.description: Maxwell saw Lena's first silt data eight years ago and funded "further study."

ties.label: oldest friends
ties.description: Julian is Maxwell's oldest friend, and the one man who lies to him for his own good.

ties.label: chain of command
ties.description: Erica reports to the Council through Maxwell. He protects her budget and ignores her memos.

ties.label: a regular at The Human Touch
ties.description: He drinks at The Human Touch without staff and talks about his father. She has never voted for him.

ties.label: the Uplift towers
ties.description: Gilda designs Maxwell's Uplift towers in Humanity Central.

ties.label: Council colleagues
ties.description: They work well together because neither trusts the other with anything important.

ties.label: former colleagues
ties.description: Co-authors at Neonix University until Nova chose transformation over research. They still trade parts and insults.

ties.label: teacher and expelled student
ties.description: Alex was Lena's grad student until he hacked the grant system and found who really pays her. He never told her.

ties.label: sensor logs, bought quietly
ties.description: She called Gael a crank on a broadcast. Now she buys his sensor logs through a cutout.

ties.label: samples and theories
ties.description: Morgana sends Lena tissue samples from the wards. Together they're closing in on a truth neither wants.

ties.label: mother and son
ties.description: Max was born Max Trueborn. He took his father's name and every implant he could afford.

ties.label: opposite prophets
ties.description: She says the body is sacred; he says it's a cage. Each is right about something.

ties.label: share a ward
ties.description: Purist clinics serve the Gloomscape. Eva and Morgana share a ward and an argument about filters.

ties.label: uneasy allies
ties.description: Both warn that the city is killing itself. She can't forgive the implant in his throat.

ties.label: public enemies
ties.description: Eva calls mutants a warning. Zara calls the Purists a eugenics club with better knitting.

ties.label: former lovers, Riot Corps
ties.description: They served in the Riot Corps and were together six years after. Neither says who left.

ties.label: the orchestra case
ties.description: Erica's longest open case is a heist pattern she calls "the orchestra."

ties.label: the open Carmine file
ties.description: Erica has kept the Carmine Night file open for six years.

ties.label: informant and handler
ties.description: Alex feeds Erica tips on the Iron Syndicate, and she keeps him out of lockup.

ties.label: best friends
ties.description: They grew up two doors apart. Riley fixes Mia's taps, and Mia feeds Riley.

ties.label: on again, off again
ties.description: On, off, on. She likes him most when he's scared, which only she gets to see.

ties.label: her mother's filters
ties.description: Every month the jar pays Ivor for her mother's filters.

ties.label: house rules
ties.description: Milo tries to hold meetings at The Human Touch. Mia makes him order a drink and keep the business off her bar.

ties.label: Last Call circle
ties.description: Borin taught her to change a keg in under a minute, and she taught him a cocktail he pretends to hate.

ties.label: friends across the feud
ties.description: Borin left the Stonefist and opened a bar on Thrain's side of the line. Thrain pays double for every drink; it's the only tithe he'll admit to.

ties.label: union against clan-king
ties.description: Brogan's Local 7 works Thrain's foundry. They fight over every contract and would die for each other in a fire.

ties.label: chief planner
ties.description: Gilda is Thrain's chief planner and the only person he lets correct him.

ties.label: the Hollow Seam debt
ties.description: Bruni's blast saved Thrain's foundry levels from a silt surge. Thrain has never thanked him in public.

ties.label: uncle and nephew
ties.description: Borin is Brond's uncle. When Brond ran from the Stonefist, Borin hid him for a week and never told the matriarch.

ties.label: the Hollow Seam rings
ties.description: Borin wears four beard rings for the crew Bruni's Hollow Seam blast left on the wrong side.

ties.label: from the same deep halls
ties.description: Brond thinks Bruni is a hero. Bruni can't stay in a room with him.

ties.label: the back booth
ties.description: Local 7 meets in Borin's back booth. Borin waters nothing and hears everything.

ties.label: joint grievance
ties.description: The Gloom has reached the foundry floor. Brogan and Morgana filed the first joint health grievance in the city's history.

ties.label: wrestling rivals
ties.description: Wrestling-pit rivals at Stonehall Stadium. The lifetime record is 14 wins each.

ties.label: the drains and the yard
ties.description: Gilda's Downflow empties into Rollo's Boneyard. He has mapped every outfall; she has never asked to see the map.

ties.label: a century of stones
ties.description: Every rest-day for a century: a game of stones on Thrombur's platform bench.

ties.label: the unbolted door
ties.description: Mara's Raiders hit Thrombur's trains. He has started leaving a freight door unbolted on the 3:10, and he'd deny it on his beard.

ties.label: former lovers
ties.description: She can't hide and he can't be seen. Four years together; he left the movement for money and left her for reasons he won't say.

ties.label: Redlight money
ties.description: Rex's Redlight money funds Zara's movement. She hates where it comes from and takes it anyway.

ties.label: mentor and protégé
ties.description: Zara pulled Sirena out of a Neon Shadows chop shop at sixteen. Sirena calls her "boss" to annoy her.

ties.label: the Council's outsiders
ties.description: The Council's two outsiders vote together and fight in private.

ties.label: the voice collar
ties.description: Nova built Zara's voice-amplifier collar and won't take payment for it.

ties.label: patron and chemist
ties.description: Felix cooks Hush under Rex's protection. Rex takes a cut and the blame.

ties.label: the crystal's secret
ties.description: Rex funds the Chrysalis Clinic. Nova is the only one who knows his crystal is silt, and that it's spreading.

ties.label: patron after the drain
ties.description: Rex took Sylph in after the drain. Sylph is the only sniper in the city who won't take a contract on the Redlight.

ties.label: old Shadows friends
ties.description: Felix patched Ghost up after every early job. Ghost is the only customer Felix ever refused to sell to.

ties.label: won't sell Hush
ties.description: Ivor refuses to sell Hush in the Breathless Bazaar. Felix takes it personally.

ties.label: dross supply
ties.description: Felix buys raw dross from the Stonefist tunnels. Bruni knows exactly which tunnels, and what they cost.

ties.label: Nova's mother
ties.description: Morgana sat with Nova's mother when the Gloom took her. Nova sends the Clinic's spare supplies down the hill in boxes she never signs.

ties.label: black-market lungs
ties.description: Ivor brokers Nova's black-market replacement lungs to Plagued who can pay.

ties.label: his body's upkeep
ties.description: Nova maintains Orion's body. He pays more than anyone.

ties.label: the chrome arm
ties.description: Nova built Blaze's red-and-chrome arm. She thinks it's the most honest thing about him.

ties.label: sisters
ties.description: Morgana heals and Echo weaponizes. They meet once a year at their mother's ribbon in the Veil of Mist.

ties.label: married eleven years, apart nine
ties.description: Ivor funds Morgana's research through three cutouts. She knows, and has never thanked him, which is how he knows she's grateful.

ties.label: closest allies
ties.description: Morgana treats; Mara feeds. Morgana doesn't know where the food comes from, or has decided not to.

ties.label: the dying patients
ties.description: Orion offers ascension to Morgana's dying patients. Some take it. She has never decided whether to stop him.

ties.label: Tuesday dinners
ties.description: Rollo hides Raider hauls under scrap. Mara brings him dinner on Tuesdays.

ties.label: Raider freight
ties.description: Jax moves the Raiders' stolen goods uphill and down.

ties.label: Raider training
ties.description: Echo trains the Gloom Raiders' crews. Morgana doesn't know.

ties.label: the two who are right
ties.description: The two men in Neonix who are right, and the two nobody listens to. Rollo's moss eats silt, and Gael's sensor proves it.

ties.label: smuggled filters
ties.description: Jax smuggles Ivor's filters and clean-mana canisters into the Gloomscape.

ties.label: the node readings
ties.description: Gael's sensor reads the DreamPlane nodes as the hottest silt sources in the city, and he preaches it at their doors.

ties.label: the two hosts
ties.description: The city's two great hosts. Lysanthir buys Redlight discretion for his guests; they trade courtesies and never meet in daylight.

ties.label: the seat deal
ties.description: Julian negotiated the deal that gave Zara her Council seat. She knows he lied to both sides to get it.

ties.label: the Redlight arrangement
ties.description: The NPD doesn't enter the Redlight without Rex's say. Erica hates the arrangement and keeps it.

ties.label: the no-vote rule
ties.description: Silvyr drafted the Fifth Chair's no-vote rule. Morgana has quoted it back to her at every session.

ties.label: foot race bets
ties.description: Sirena races Max on foot against his car. She always wins, and he keeps betting.

ties.label: the Speaker and the newest chair
ties.description: He campaigned against her seat and now needs her vote. Both of them find it funny, separately.

ties.label: unsigned filters
ties.description: Thrain sends filters to Morgana's wards in unmarked crates. He has never said why.

ties.label: the strike marshals
ties.description: Valkyrie trained Local 7's strike marshals during the last lockout. Brogan paid her in beer and an IOU.

ties.label: a suspicion
ties.description: Bruni suspects Alex talks to someone outside the crew. He hasn't said so yet.

ties.label: heavy loads
ties.description: Brond hauls the loads Jax's car can't carry. They share the middle of the napkin map.

ties.label: the moss markup
ties.description: Ivor sells Rollo's moss filters in the Bazaar at a markup Rollo doesn't know about, and sends half of it to Morgana.

ties.label: pulled from the fire
ties.description: Echo was in the burning block on the Carmine Night. Valkyrie's squad got her out before the firebreak fell. Echo knows their names; Valkyrie doesn't know hers.

ties.label: moss samples
ties.description: Felix has bought Rollo's moss twice under a false name. It eats dross, and that means it eats his business.

ties.label: the night freight question
ties.description: Elandor has asked Thrombur, politely, whose seal rides the 3:10. Thrombur said he'd check the schedule.

ties.label: what Blaze dropped
ties.description: Rollo salvaged the burned blocks after the Carmine Night. He kept the one thing Blaze dropped there.

ties.label: the first node
ties.description: Lireal built the illusion layer of the DreamPlane's first public node, before she knew what it burned. Orion still uses her work.

ties.label: the garage bouts
ties.description: Alex fights in the back-room bouts at Riley's garage. She patches his knuckle ports and charges him in parts.

ties.label: the corner outside
ties.description: Gael preaches outside Iron Spirits on rest-days. Borin sends out a mug and tells him to keep it down.

ties.label: the only sermon
ties.description: On slow nights Sylph watches Gael's corner sermons through his scope. Gael is the only preacher he listens to.

ties.label: the long way round
ties.description: Elandor plans the long way around; Brond prefers straight through. They have argued about it for twenty years.

ties.label: the statue and the squad
ties.description: Blaze got the statue; her squad got a line on its base. He visits the line at night.

ties.label: the city's two famous mercs
ties.description: Blaze is loved; Ghost is feared. Each wants the other's reputation.

ties.label: broker and client
ties.description: Milo is Blaze's broker and the architect of his legend.

ties.label: the job that killed her squad
ties.description: Milo brokered the job that killed Valkyrie's squad. She still takes his calls, and that's the part she can't explain.

ties.label: broker and client
ties.description: Milo books Ghost for the jobs Blaze is too famous to take.

ties.label: won't work for him
ties.description: The Shade Pacers won't work through Milo. It eats at him.

ties.label: the Carmine Night plan
ties.description: Elara planned the Carmine Night. Valkyrie doesn't know the planner's name.

ties.label: planner and broker
ties.description: She plans; he staffs. Neither has ever trusted the other, which makes them reliable.

ties.label: old crew, old grudge
ties.description: They came up together in the Neon Shadows. Ghost left Sylph behind on a job gone bad; Sylph waited three days in a drain. Sylph always knows where Ghost is.

ties.label: two men called Ghost
ties.description: Jax had the name first. Ghost Nakamura has never asked about it, and Jax has never stopped mentioning it.

ties.label: a treaty on a napkin
ties.description: Jax and the Runners split the city's illegal freight. The border is a map Elandor drew on a napkin at Iron Spirits.

ties.label: door and illusion
ties.description: She builds the illusion, and he punches through the door it hides.

ties.label: her canisters
ties.description: Bruni builds Echo's canisters. He's the only one she lets close.

ties.label: silent overwatch
ties.description: Sylph and Echo share overwatch. Neither talks, and both prefer it.

ties.label: eyes on the roof
ties.description: Sylph is the only Pacer Lireal has never tried to read.

ties.label: route and driver
ties.description: Elandor plans the route Max ignores. Max is alive because Elandor plans for that too.

ties.label: mechanic and driver
ties.description: Riley builds Max's cars and refuses to ride in them.

ties.label: moss filter housings
ties.description: Riley builds housings for Rollo's moss filters in her off hours. She's the first uptown hand to take them seriously.

ties.label: the annual job
ties.description: Sirena runs one Neon Shadows job a year for Rex, the price of getting out. Zara doesn't know.

ties.label: bodyguard and friend
ties.description: Brond guards Sirena on jobs and pretends he isn't her friend.

ties.label: engine and map
ties.description: Elandor tells her what the road needs; Riley tells him what the engine can give. They're never both happy.
